edits.headline: Iranian missiles damage US aircraft at Jordan air base
edits.subheadline: US officials said no American personnel were killed in the attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported.
editorialBody: An Iranian missile attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan on September 8 severely damaged a US A-10 aircraft and lightly damaged about eight F-15E jets, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported, citing CBS News. US officials said no American personnel were killed.
The SEC's rewrite of its crypto custody rules has entered White House review, The Defiant reported.
